method: Strict Leadership Principles (LPs) framing for behavioral answers (Customer Obsession, Ownership, Bias for Action, Dive Deep, Earn Trust, Have Backbone; Disagree and Commit)
Expect concrete quantifiable customer impact, ownership metrics, and specific individual contributions ('I' vs 'we')
Bar-raiser standard: candidate must raise the bar relative to current team peers; consistent sound judgment under ambiguity

entry-level: Customer obsession demonstrated through personal projects or coursework delivery
Learn and be curious: rapid acquisition of new tools and willingness to dive deep into debugging
Writing clean, modular code with solid understanding of algorithmic efficiency
mid-level: Clear end-to-end ownership of services, APIs, and operational metrics (alarms, latency p99)
Bias for action with calculated risk-taking; delivering two-way door decisions autonomously
Thorough root-cause analysis on past outages or production incidents
senior: Architectural leadership across multi-tier distributed systems with strict SLAs
Frugality and operational excellence: optimizing cloud costs and reducing operational friction
Demonstrated ability to influence cross-org stakeholders and raise the engineering bar
staff-plus: Think Big: Defining multi-year distributed systems roadmaps spanning org boundaries
Invent and Simplify: Replacing complex legacy systems with scalable, decoupled primitives
Executive communication and technical governance across entire VP organizations

swe: Distributed architecture fundamentals: DynamoDB/NoSQL modeling, SQS/SNS decoupling, idempotent APIs
Concurrency, error handling, retry policies with jitter/exponential backoff, and circuit breakers
ml-data: SageMaker / distributed training pipelines, real-time feature extraction, low-latency model inference
Data consistency, schema evolution, and cost-effective data warehousing on Redshift/S3
sre-infra: Operational excellence: high-cardinality CloudWatch metrics, automated deployment pipelines, canary analysis
Multi-AZ / Multi-Region resilience, cell-based architecture, and blast-radius containment
pm-design: Working Backwards: writing Press Release / FAQ (PR/FAQ) artifacts before building
Deep customer discovery, ruthless prioritization, and metric-driven business outcomes
em-lead: Hire and Develop the Best: continuous talent assessment and clear career progression coaching
Managing operational burden, technical debt, and high-velocity roadmap commitments

frequentThemes.shape: Past example with customer impact, measurable telemetry, and specific personal trade-offs made under pressure
Design an asynchronous, fault-tolerant processing pipeline handling high burst traffic with decoupled storage
Scenario where candidate had strong technical conviction against team consensus, gathered data, and navigated outcome

sourcesNote: Curated from public Amazon Leadership Principles and technical interview standards
